title: Mediterranean Roasted Whole Fish

items.item: whole Branzino fish (or other mild white fish), cleaned, deboned and butterflied

instructions: Ask your fishmonger to clean, debone and butterfly your fish! Preheat the oven to 500 degrees.
Place the fish on a sheet pan. Open up the fish. Coat the flesh with 1 tsp of olive oil and salt and pepper.
On the bottom half of the fish, spread the crushed garlic and red pepper flakes. Layer the basil on next, followed by 3 lemon slices.
Close the fish back up and with a sharp knife, score the skin of the top of the fish 3 times (this will prevent the fish from curling up).
Coat the outer skin with the remaining tsp of olive oil. Lightly salt and pepper the skin.
Roast the fish for about 10 min. The flesh should flake but still be moist and the skin should be crisp.
If you like, drizzle a tiny bit more olive oil over the finished fish and serve.
